Reusable Agent Contexts - validated conversations with pinned source evidence
|-- [M] Conversation value: AgentContext
|   |-- Public boundary
|   |   |-- Construct: fromTrajectory / fromMessages / fromSnapshot
|   |   |-- Derive: withMessages / resolveSources -> new validated context
|   |   `-- Export: toSnapshot / withoutSourceFiles / toPiMessages
|   |-- [O] Private snapshot belongs to the value
|   |   |-- Constructor and toSnapshot clone data; callers cannot mutate internal state
|   |   `-- Validation, canonicalization and hashing stay internal; no SDK or direct I/O
|   |-- [C] fromTrajectory -> select one ancestral slice -> validate -> hash
|   |   |-- Walk parent IDs from throughEntryId back to fromEntryId; reverse into order
|   |   |-- Reject duplicate entry IDs, cycles, missing entries and disconnected endpoints
|   |   `-- Tool-call coherence
|   |       |-- Assistant call IDs are unique across the selected conversation
|   |       |-- Each result must match a pending call ID and tool name exactly once
|   |       `-- All calls need results before another user/assistant message or slice end
|   |-- [D] contentHash = SHA-256(canonical snapshot data)
|   |   |-- Inputs: version + source identity + selected entry range + ordered messages
|   |   |-- Messages contain text, pinned source ranges, sections and assistant tool calls
|   |   |-- Named sections retain their order and contribute to the hash
|   |   |-- Derived version: sections -> 3; otherwise source ranges -> 2; otherwise -> 1
|   |   `-- Attached sourceFiles are excluded; their hashes are carried by range descriptors
|   |-- [C] fromSnapshot -> verify descriptor hash, message coherence and attachment validity
|   |   |-- Supplied files must match their hash keys and be referenced by snapshot ranges
|   |   `-- Supplied files must cover their selected ranges; missing files may resolve later
|   `-- [C] resolveSources -> toPiMessages -> reusable model input
|       |-- Each range: attached snapshot file, else injected reader, else unavailable error
|       |-- Equal range descriptors share one read promise within this resolution
|       |-- Replace ranges with path:line-line labels and selected text; preserve sections
|       |-- Enforce 16 MiB expanded-source budget; return a newly hashed context
|       `-- Model conversion emits section boundary labels and rejects unresolved ranges
|           `-- Imported assistant provenance marks history; it does not choose the run model
|-- [M] Durable library: AgentContextLibrary
|   |-- Public operations: create / read / list / update / fork / addComment / lineage
|   |-- Depends on AgentContext + saved-record schemas
|   |   |-- AgentContextRepository port -> record storage [R]
|   |   `-- Optional AgentContextSources port -> source capture and resolution [S]
|   |-- [C] create(requestId, metadata, explicit context)
|   |   |-- Plain text -> one user message
|   |   |-- Text/sourceFile constituents, optionally in sections
|   |   |   `-- Capture sourceFile items sequentially through [S] -> pinned source ranges
|   |   |-- Supplied snapshot -> AgentContext.fromSnapshot
|   |   `-- Validated context -> [S].persist when available -> [R].create -> summary
|   |       |-- Saved ID = saved-agent-context-<request UUID>
|   |       |-- Existing ID + same requestHash -> return existing record
|   |       |-- Existing ID + different requestHash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |       `-- Constituent requests check their receipt before recapturing source files
|   |-- [C] read(id, resolveSources=true)
|   |   |-- [R].read -> validate snapshot -> return metadata and compact snapshot
|   |   `-- Ranges present and resolution requested -> separate resolvedSnapshot
|   |       `-- Stored snapshot and its contentHash remain unchanged
|   |-- [C] fork -> new saved identity with copied pinned snapshot
|   |   |-- Matching prior request receipt returns the existing fork
|   |   |-- Otherwise require parent's current hash to equal expectedContentHash
|   |   |-- Record parent ID + parent hash; inherit description/group unless overridden
|   |   `-- Parent comments stay on the parent
|   |-- [O] Metadata evolves independently of model-visible content
|   |   |-- update sets or clears group; snapshot and creation receipt stay unchanged
|   |   `-- addComment appends text + timestamp + expected content hash
|   |       `-- Matching UUID retry adds nothing; conflicting retry or stale hash fails
|   `-- Discovery and ancestry
|       |-- list -> name/description filter -> newest first, ID tie-break -> pagination
|       `-- lineage -> follow parent IDs -> root-first summaries with parentMatches
|           `-- Missing ancestors or cyclic ancestry fail explicitly
|-- [M] Pinned evidence: source-range contract + FileAgentContextSources [S]
|   |-- Public boundary: capture / read / persist / portable
|   |-- Depends on source registry -> CorpusBinding -> Git or corpus provider
|   |   `-- Registry selects the source root; callers supply validated relative paths
|   |-- [D] Selected source text needs a descriptor AND its pinned bytes
|   |   |-- Descriptor: sourceId + path + inclusive startLine/endLine + version
|   |   |-- Git version -> commit + registered repository + path -> committed file
|   |   |-- Snapshot version -> contentHash -> file or evidence slice
|   |   |   `-- File hash = SHA-256(JSON({startLine, lines})); original offset is retained
|   |   `-- Range bounds + file offset -> selected lines; out-of-bounds selection fails
|   |-- [C] capture -> choose a stable backing version
|   |   |-- Explicit revision, else Git binding revision, when present
|   |   |   `-- Resolve revision to commit -> read pinned regular Git file
|   |   `-- No revision -> read corpus content
|   |       |-- Git worktree bytes equal HEAD bytes -> retain Git commit reference
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> hash captured file -> put immutable snapshot blob
|   |-- [C] persist(snapshot)
|   |   `-- Validate -> store supplied attachments -> load/check distinct references
|   |       `-- Return descriptor without attachments; contentHash stays the same
|   |-- [C] portable(snapshot)
|   |   `-- Load each distinct range -> retain only selected lines and original offset
|   |       `-- Hash slices -> rewrite ranges as snapshot references -> attach slices
|   |           `-- withMessages revalidates and rehashes the resulting descriptor
|   `-- [O] Adapter retains source storage and bounded read cache
|       |-- ImmutableRecords under agent-context-sources retains snapshot blobs
|       |-- Git references reuse committed bytes without a copied source blob
|       |-- Cache key = repository root + commit + path; repeated ranges share file reads
|       `-- Keep at most 16 cached promises; evict failed reads so later calls can retry
|-- [M] Record persistence: FileAgentContextRepository [R]
|   |-- Public boundary: read / create / updateGroup / addComment / summaries
|   |-- Depends on saved-record validation + AgentContext validation + filesystem
|   |-- [O] Application store retains globally addressable records under agent-contexts
|   |   `-- Saved records have no canvas or chat binding and survive process restarts
|   |-- [C] create -> exclusive temporary file -> write + sync + close
|   |   `-- Hard-link to final ID atomically -> sync directory -> read published record
|   |       |-- Existing final record is checked against requestHash
|   |       `-- Finally remove temporary file; opened handles close in finally blocks
|   `-- [C/O] Metadata mutation owns a per-record lock for the update
|       |-- Acquire lock directory; contention waits 10 ms between attempts, up to 5 s
|       |-- Read -> mutate metadata -> validate -> write/sync temporary file
|       |-- Rename over record -> sync directory -> return updated record
|       `-- Finally remove temporary file and release lock, including on failure
`-- [M] Diagram binding: compile / store / load / validate diagram context
    |-- Depends on AgentContext + source-range values + DiagramAgentContextStore port
    |-- [D] Compiled context needs diagram identity and captured source evidence
    |   |-- sourceFingerprint = SHA-256(JSON({binding, evidence}))
    |   |-- Evidence originalLines + offsets -> attached slices and snapshot references
    |   `-- Capture diagramId + compiledFromRevisionId + sourceFingerprint
    |-- [C] compileDiagramAgentContext -> inline AgentContext snapshot
    |   `-- Captured evidence is background; each later edit supplies its current diagram
    |-- [O] Diagram carries either inline snapshot or backingRecordId + contentHash
    |   |-- store -> validate -> put inline snapshot -> return compact backing reference
    |   `-- Inline form supports older workspaces and portable exports
    `-- [C] load -> inline snapshot or store.get -> AgentContext.fromSnapshot
        `-- Require expected hash, diagram-context agent type and matching diagram ID
